name: Bridging (Reformer)
summary: Heels on the footbar, hips lift into a bridge. Three versions: carriage held still, carriage pressed out and in with the hips up, and starting with the hips dropped low.
steps: Headrest down. Lie on the back with the heels on the footbar hip-width apart, arms long.
Breathe out to lift the hips, peeling the spine off the carriage.
Breathe out to lower the spine and pelvis back down.

layers.title: Bridge and press
layers.text: Hips up; press the carriage out and in without dropping them.

layers.title: Low start
layers.text: Hands on the shoulder rests, hips dropped towards the springs; press out, lift, return, lower.

layers.title: Hip dips and pulses
layers.text: Small lowers and lifts at the top.

layers.title: Single leg
layers.text: One leg long or in tabletop.

modifications: All springs on to lock the carriage for tight or cramping hamstrings.
Feet on the platform instead of the bar.

cautions.note: Lift with a long spine instead of rolling.
Hinge up with a neutral spine.

cues:
One line from knees to shoulders at the top.
Weight on the shoulder blades, never the neck.
Knees and feet stay hip-width — no rolling in or out.
The carriage stays parked unless the layer says otherwise.

review.note: Draft entry written for OpenPilates. Needs review by a qualified Pilates instructor before teaching from it.
